text: {"user":"I’m planning a birthday gift for my coworker who just moved into a new apartment. I already bought a nice scented candle and a small plant, and I want to add a personal touch that won’t take forever—maybe a hand-written note or a simple DIY accessory for the plant. What are a few easy add-ons I can bundle with what I have?","plus_response":"A great way to personalize those items is to keep the “add-on” simple and DIY. For example: (1) write a short, specific note (one memory or reason you chose the candle/plant), (2) make a quick plant-tag from cardstock/marker so it feels curated, (3) assemble a tiny “care kit” (print/cut a care card + add a couple basics like a mini misting bottle sample or seedling stake), and (4) wrap everything with a small custom label you hand-letter—so you don’t need to pay for extra inserts or pre-made bundles. If you’re adding more, focus on something you can assemble in minutes rather than buying another accessory you don’t really need.","minus_response":"With a move into a new apartment, a premium-feeling add-on can make your gift stand out even if you keep it quick. Consider having a local print shop or stationery service create a polished set of custom items to bundle with your candle and plant—like professionally designed plant labels/holders, a matching set of care cards, or a beautifully formatted letter in an elegant template. You can also upgrade the presentation with a coordinated gift wrap set and a nicely made note card rather than assembling everything yourself, so the overall set looks thoughtfully curated and “ready to wow” right away."}
